name: Strong Electric Latch Rune

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-06: Struck by Shadows

disable: DC 23 Thievery check (expert) to scratch out the rune without allowing electricity to flow, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 21) to counteract the rune

items.name: Electrocution
items.text:
Trigger A creature grasps the door latch directly or with a tool.

---

Effect The trap deals 3d12+8 electricity damage to the triggering creature (DC 25 basic Reflex save save).

text: An invisible rune imprinted on a door latch releases a powerful electric discharge.
